# Dear ImGui

[Dear ImGui](https://github.com/ocornut/imgui) v1.92.9b (MIT, `LICENSE.txt`), for the overlay
(docs/OVERLAY.md): the core, and the back ends for Metal, OpenGL 3, Direct3D 12 and SDL3. From the
release archive `v1.92.9b.tar.gz`, SHA-256 `21d8a0a565e85dce943e375db00812c2f3f0ab21f3f0f7964e364a63422d7f99`;
unchanged.

`fonts/roboto_medium.h`: Roboto Medium by Christian Robertson (Apache License 2.0), from ImGui's
`misc/fonts`, compressed into C by its `binary_to_compressed_c`.
